en: He insisted that the budget be revised immediately.
tr: Bütçenin derhal gözden geçirilmesi konusunda ısrar etti.
ipa: /hiː ɪnˈsɪstɪd ðæt ðə ˈbʌdʒɪt biː rɪˈvaɪzd ɪˈmiːdiətli/
trPron: hi insistid det dı bacit bi rivayzd imiydiyetli
commonMistake: He insisted that the budget is revised. ❌
aiExplain: 'Insist' fiilinden sonra gelen 'that' yapısında zorunluluk/önem vurgusu olduğu için fiil yalın halde veya 'should' ile kullanılır (Subjunctive mood).

en: She admitted that she had forgotten the document.

tense: Tense mismatch (missing Past Perfect for prior event)
collocations: She admitted that she forgot the document. (Less precise)

en: They argued that the project was still viable.

commonMistake: They discussed that the project was viable. (Passive/Vague)

en: The chairman declared that the company was secure.

scenario: Correcting mistake of adding 'about' after the verb discuss
highlights: reported that they discussed the audit
pattern: Subject + reported + that + Subject + Past Simple (No Preposition) + Noun
en: The auditor reported that they discussed the audit results.
ipa: /ði ˈɔːdɪtə rɪˈpɔːtɪd ðæt ðeɪ dɪˈskʌst ði ˈɔːdɪt rɪˈzʌlts/
trPron: di oditır riportid det dey diskast di odit rizolts
commonMistake: The auditor reported that they discussed about the results. ❌
aiExplain: 'Discuss' geçişlidir. Reported speech içinde de 'about' alamaz. 'They discussed the audit' kurgusu hatasızdır.

scenario: Correcting mistake of omitting 'to' after the verb listen

scenario: Correcting mistake of saying 'depend to' instead of 'depend on'

scenario: Correcting mistake of saying 'good in' instead of 'good at'
